controls.label: Shape
controls.title: Published nonconvex DAMIT model 1816, version 2017-05-26, at its original kilometer scale. The shared grid marks unavailable imagery. This is a ground-based shape reconstruction, not a photographic surface or a measured reflectance map. Observational constraints are uneven. Lighting uses the documented pole and an arbitrary display phase.
controls.summary: Shape made from changes in brightness as the asteroid rotates. Gray grid: no surface imagery.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.title: Color shows the original model radius minus a 56 km reference sphere. It includes global shape and is not height above a gravitational equipotential. This is a derived view of the same reconstruction, not an independent measured topographic map. Display resolution adds no observational detail.
controls.summary: Distance above or below a reference sphere. Colors include the body's shape as well as local terrain.
